Yash Shares His Son's Emotional Reaction to His Ravana Performance in 'Ramayana'

02 Nov 2026, 10:33 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: timesofindia.indiatimes.com

Image: The Times of India · Photo source · Resized and letterboxed to 16:9; no AI generation

Key takeaways A Young Viewer's Perspective Actor Yash, who portrays the complex character of Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari’s upcoming epic *Ramayana: Rise of a Legend*, recently shared insights into his children’s reactions after they watched the film during a premiere. According to Yash

A Young Viewer's Perspective

Actor Yash, who portrays the complex character of Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari’s upcoming epic *Ramayana: Rise of a Legend*, recently shared insights into his children’s reactions after they watched the film during a premiere. According to Yash and his co-star Sai Pallavi, his young son, Yatharv, was particularly affected by the narrative.

The Battle of Ravana and Jatayu

The film features a depiction of the legendary battle between Ravana and Jatayu. Yash recalled that while his children, Ayra and Yatharv, are familiar with his work as an actor, this specific encounter proved difficult for his son. Sai Pallavi shared that Yatharv was visibly upset by the scene, telling his father, "I didn't like you killing that bird. I don't think you should have done that."

Portraying Ravana Beyond the Villain Archetype

Yash emphasized the effort required to move beyond a one-dimensional portrayal of Ravana:

  • Internal Strength: Yash stated that he focused on conveying power through the character's eyes, intellect, and vulnerability rather than solely relying on physical appearance.
  • Complexity: The actor aimed to highlight the nuanced qualities of Ravana, seeking to offer audiences a perspective that moves beyond simple "black and white" morality.
  • Avoiding Clichés: Yash noted that he intentionally avoided playing the character with typical arrogance, opting instead for sarcasm, wit, and a touch of vulnerability.

Film Details

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the star-studded cast includes:

  • Ranbir Kapoor as Rama
  • Sai Pallavi as Sita
  • Yash as Ravana
  • Sunny Deol as Hanuman
  • Ravi Dubey as Lakshmana

The music for the project is a collaboration between Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. *Ramayana: Rise of a Legend* is currently scheduled for a worldwide release on November 5, 2026. Official trailers and further updates regarding the film's production can be verified through the official social media channels of the film’s production house.
